plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Lurene Tuttle is credited on 370 distinct recordings across 35 programs from 1937-12-23 through 1979-07-25. Documented roles include performer on 368 recordings, commercial spokesman on 2 recordings, and intermission guest on 1 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are The Red Skelton Show (performer on 88 recordings; 88 distinct recordings), The Great Gildersleeve (performer on 85 recordings; 85 distinct recordings), The Adventures of Sam Spade (performer on 55 recordings; 55 distinct recordings), Strange Wills (performer on 19 recordings; 19 distinct recordings), The Whistler (performer on 14 recordings; 14 distinct recordings), Dr. Christian (performer on 11 recordings; 11 distinct recordings), Let George Do It (performer on 10 recordings; 10 distinct recordings), and Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 8 recordings, commercial spokesman on 2 recordings, and intermission guest on 1 recording; 10 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Marjorie Forrester (85 portrayals) and Effie Perrine (55 portrayals).
